question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_id,
        SUM(CAST(oi.price AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales,
        AVG(CAST(oi.price AS DOUBLE)) AS average_item_price,
        AVG(CAST(rev.review_score AS DOUBLE)) AS average_review_score,
        AVG(CAST((date(order_delivered_carrier_date) - date(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS DOUBLE) * 24.0) AS average_packing_time_hours,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS quantity_sold
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_reviews rev ON oi.order_id = rev.order_id
    GROUP BY s.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(CAST(oi.price AS DOUBLE)) AS category_total_sales,
        ptc.product_category_name_english,
        p.product_category_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_reviews rev ON oi.order_id = rev.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation ptc ON p.product_category_name = ptc.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, ptc.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        category_total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_total_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_sales,
    sm.average_item_price,
    sm.average_review_score,
    sm.average_packing_time_hours,
    sm.quantity_sold,
    tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english
FROM seller_metrics sm
JOIN top_categories tc ON sm.seller_id = tc.seller_id AND tc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC

WITH seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_id,
        ptc.product_category_name_english,

        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS category_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation ptc ON p.product_category_name = ptc.product_category_name
    GROUP BY s.seller_id, ptc.product_category_name_english
),
seller_top_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        category_sales,
        category_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) AS rn
    FROM seller_category_sales
),
seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_id,
        SUM(CAST(oi.price AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales,
        AVG(CAST(oi.price AS DOUBLE)) AS average_item_price,
        AVG(CAST(rev.review_score AS DOUBLE)) AS average_review_score,
        AVG(CAST((date(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS DOUBLE) * 24.0) AS average_packing_time_hours,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS quantity_sold
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_reviews rev ON oi.order_id = rev.order_id
    GROUP BY s.seller_id

    stc.product_category_name_english,
    stc.category_sales,
    stc.category_quantity
FROM seller_metrics sm
